arxiv-2010-07353.title: On the number of partitions of n n whose product of the summands is at most n n
arxiv-2010-07353.creator: Pankaj Jyoti Mahanta
arxiv-2010-07353.description: Abstract . We prove an explicit formula to count the partitions of n n whose product of the summands is at most n n . In the process, we also deduce a result to count the multiplicative partitions of n n . 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification 11P81, 05A17. 1.

arxiv-2204-09181.title: CLASSY III: The Properties of Starburst-Driven Warm Ionized Outflows Journal: AASJournal ApJ Based on observations made with the NASA/ESA Hubble Space Telescope, obtained from the Data Archive at the Space Telescope Science Institute, which is operated by the Association of Universities for Research
arxiv-2204-09181.creator: Xinfeng Xu, Timothy Heckman, Alaina Henry, Danielle A. Berg, John Chisholm, Bethan L. James, Crystal L. Martin, Daniel P. Stark, Alessandra Aloisi, Ricardo O. Amorín, Karla Z. Arellano-Córdova, Rongmon Bordoloi, Stéphane Charlot, Zuyi Chen, Matthew Hayes, Matilde Mingozzi, Yuma Sugahara, Lisa J. Kew
arxiv-2204-09181.description: Abstract We report the results of analyses of galactic outflows in a sample of 45 low-redshift starburst galaxies in the COS Legacy Archive Spectroscopic SurveY (CLASSY), augmented by five additional similar starbursts with COS data. The outflows are traced by blueshifted absorption-lines of metals spanning a wide range of ionization potential.

arxiv-2212-01474.title: Nondestructive KPFM-assisted Quality Control in Fabrication of GaAs High-Speed Electronics
arxiv-2212-01474.creator: Alexander Shurakov, Natalia Kaurova, Ivan Belikov, Tatyana Zilberley, Anatoliy Prikhodko, Boris Voronov, Gregory Gol’tsman
arxiv-2212-01474.description: Abstract In this paper, we report on the method of nondestructive quality control that can be used in fabrication of GaAs high-speed electronics. The method relies on the surface potential mapping and enables rigid in vivo analysis of transport properties of an active electronic device incorporated into a complex integrated circuit.

arxiv-2401-13101.title: Singlet Dirac dark matter streamlined
arxiv-2401-13101.creator: Carlos E. Yaguna, Óscar Zapata
arxiv-2401-13101.description: Abstract We propose a new and compact realization of singlet Dirac dark matter within the WIMP framework. Our model replaces the standard Z 2 Z_{2} stabilizing symmetry with a Z 6 Z_{6} , and uses spontaneous symmetry breaking to generate the dark matter mass, resulting in a much simplified scenario for Dirac dark matter.

arxiv-2403-14054.title: Adaptive finite element interpolated neural networks
arxiv-2403-14054.creator: Santiago Badia 1,2,∗, Wei Li 1, Alberto F. Martín 3
arxiv-2403-14054.description: Abstract . The use of neural networks to approximate partial differential equations (PDEs) has gained significant attention in recent years. However, the approximation of PDEs with localised phenomena, e.g., sharp gradients and singularities, remains a challenge, due to ill-defined cost functions in terms of pointwise residual sampling or poor numerical integration.

arxiv-2503-22670.title: Toward single-photon detection with superconducting niobium diselenide nanowires
arxiv-2503-22670.creator: Pietro Metuh, Athanasios Paralikis, Paweł Wyborski, Sherwan Jamo, Alessandro Palermo, Lucio Zugliani, Matteo Barbone, Kai Müller, Niels Gregersen, Saulius Vaitiekėnas, Jonathan Finley, Battulga Munkhbat
arxiv-2503-22670.description: Abstract We present superconducting nanowire single-photon detectors (SNSPDs) based on few-layer NbSe 2 fully encapsulated with hexagonal boron nitride (hBN), demonstrating single-photon sensitivity. Our fabrication process preserves the superconducting properties of NbSe 2 in nanowires, as confirmed by low-temperature transport measurements that show a critical temperature of T c ≈ 6.5 T_{c}\approx 6.

arxiv-2512-10509.title: Flat groups of automorphisms of totally disconnected, locally compact groups
arxiv-2512-10509.creator: George A. Willis
arxiv-2512-10509.description: Abstract A group, ℋ \mathscr{H} , of automorphisms of a totally disconnected locally compact group, G G , is flat if there is a compact open U ≤ G U\leq G such that the index [ α ( U ) : U ∩ α ( U ) ] [\alpha(U):U\cap\alpha(U)] is mininimized for every α ∈ ℋ \alpha\in\mathscr{H} .

pmc-10617915.title: Antineutrophil cytoplasmic antibody-associated vasculitis with systemic sclerosis: a fatal case report
pmc-10617915.creator: Naram Khalayli, Raghad Ibrahim, Rahaf Ibrahim, Maysoun Kudsi
pmc-10617915.description: Introduction and importance:Antineutrophil cytoplasmic antibody (ANCA)-associated vasculitis is a rare co-occurrence with systemic sclerosis, in around 2.5–9% of patients. The clinical manifestations and prognosis of vasculitis in systemic sclerosis depend on organ involvement. It presented with rapidly progressive acute renal failure without malignant hypertension, and with pitting hand and foot ulcers get along with purpuric vasculitis in some cases reports.

pmc-10738854.title: STRATEGIES USED TO HELP OLDER ADULTS ACCESS VIDEO VISITS DURING COVID-19: A SYSTEMATIC REVIEW
pmc-10738854.creator: Landon Haller, Rena Rodriguez, Lindsay (Na Yeon) Park, Kenneth Lam
pmc-10738854.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Many articles have described how older adults struggled to access telemedicine during the COVID-19 pandemic, but few have described how that digital divide was bridged. To comprehensively describe strategies used to help older adults access telemedicine during the pandemic, we conducted a systematic review of 4 databases (PubMed, EMBASE, CINAHL, and PsycInfo) for English articles (search terms: “tele*”, “mHealth”, “eHealth”, “video*”, “65 and older”) published from March 2020 to July 2022.

pmc-11303149.title: Association between caffeine intake from foods and beverages in the diet and hearing loss in United States adults
pmc-11303149.creator: Fei Xia, Yuanyuan Ren
pmc-11303149.description: BackgroundHearing loss (HL) is the third most prevalent condition, significantly affecting individuals and society. Recent research has explored the potential impact of nutrition, particularly caffeine intake, on HL. While some studies focus on coffee, caffeine intake should be assessed across all dietary sources. This study examines the association between dietary caffeine intake and HL.

pmc-11497596.title: Modeling human activity comprehension at human scale: Prediction, segmentation, and categorization
pmc-11497596.creator: Tan T Nguyen, Matthew A Bezdek, Samuel J Gershman, Aaron F Bobick, Todd S Braver, Jeffrey M Zacks, Stephen Fleming
pmc-11497596.description: Humans form sequences of event models—representations of the current situation—to predict how activity will unfold. Multiple mechanisms have been proposed for how the cognitive system determines when to segment the stream of behavior and switch from one active event model to another.

pmc-13110761.title: Trisoxazole Macrolides Potentiate the Microtubule Assembly and Antimitotic Activities of Taxanes
pmc-13110761.creator: Shohei Ebihara, Rio Takaiso, Shota Kawaguchi, Atsunori Oshima, Masaki Kita
pmc-13110761.description: Mycalolides are marine‐derived trisoxazole macrolides that exhibit potent actin‐depolymerizing activity and inhibit the proliferation, migration, and invasion of various cancer cells. The C25–C35 side‐chain moiety of mycalolides is important for their actin‐binding properties; however, the biological function of the C1–C24 trisoxazole macrolactone moiety remains largely unexplored.

pmc-13596914.title: Heat stress responses of plants during adaptation to high temperature environments: A review of recent advances and insights
pmc-13596914.creator: Xinsong Wei, Huankai Zhang, Ruize Ma, Jie Zang, Yan Wang, Caiyu Yu
pmc-13596914.description: Plants, as sessile organisms, continuously encounter diverse environmental challenges, often experiencing multiple abiotic stresses during their development and growth. Among these stress events, heat has emerged as an increasingly severe factor because of global warming and currently poses a major threat to plant development, crop productivity, and agricultural sustainability.
